name: @taste-and-see/worker-media-processor
description: Media-processor worker (TS-201; subsumes the scaffold half of TS-110-followup-1). A separate long-running process that walks an uploaded media object through the mandatory CLAUDE.md §3.4 pipeline — magic-byte MIME validation → ClamAV virus scan → Sharp image resize OR ffmpeg video transcode (HLS manifest + poster) — and reports each stage outcome to media-svc's internal scan-event ingest. Ships stub-by-default (no Docker/ffmpeg/ClamAV/S3 required); live adapters are deferred per ADR-0002. The asset only becomes consumable (`ready`) after both the scan and the processing stage pass; a degraded scanner fails closed to `rejected`.
